description: LoRA Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning Attention Module (v2, Production-Hardened).  Replaces standard Q/K/V/O projections with frozen pretrained base weights plus trainable low-rank residual adapters, with multi-architecture weight transfer, GQA, RoPE, and causal decoding support.  This is intentionally an attention-swap module, NOT a compressor:   - Base weights are frozen.   - Only LoRA A/B are tr
